spec_match.rationale: Exercises the exact CSS Color 4 contract — background: AccentColor / color: AccentColorText against an element's effective accent-color — with a two-element differing probe that mirrors the WPT accent-color-keyword-resolution expectations.

interactive.rationale: Swatch picker (buttons with aria-pressed) drives accent-color on a live region containing native checkbox/radio/range/progress plus the keyword-styled chip; readout re-reads getComputedStyle on every pick.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the canonical pick-an-accent/mirror comparison with a three-tier probe; the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Three honest tiers are distinguished and reported: keywords unparsed (stock pre-158), parse-but-static system accent (flagged pre-158), and follows-value; accent-color: auto is a dedicated swatch.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/6207138742534144, the CSS Color 4 spec section, and the sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The new feature-level suite asserts parse, own/inherited/update mirroring, AccentColorText contrast pairs, cycle-breaking and currentcolor — every automatic assertion can and does fail on Chromium 141 (verified 0 pass / 9 fail / 1 blocked).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless: CDP-driven swatch clicks and keyboard Enter activation verified readout updates, honest fallback text, clean console, and screenshots at both viewports; the follows-value success tier cannot be exercised on this container's Chromium 141 (keywords absent even behind flags) and awaits a real Chrome 158/Canary pass.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert covers the probe tier (fallback branch explicitly labelled honest-unsupported) and the mirror-match contract on the follows tier; no console noise observed.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for static text/background pairs; selected swatch flips to black/ivory with a blue outline; chip fallback is stone/charcoal (AA); the only non-variable colours are the accent values the feature itself consumes (swatch dots, no text on them).

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with aria-pressed, visible focus (verified :focus-visible via CDP keyboard walk, Enter activates), labelled range/progress, 44px targets, and a single polite role=status readout.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at emulated 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth === innerWidth), panes stack via auto-fit grid, swatches wrap, screenshots of both classes read and judged legible.

openQuestions.title: Verify the follows-value tier on real Chrome 158+/Canary
openQuestions.detail: Chromium 141 in the build container cannot parse AccentColor even behind --enable-blink-features=CSSAccentColorKeyword,CSSSystemAccentColor (that only reaches the static tier), so the success path — chip background === computed accent-color, the accentcolor-mirrors-accent-color telemetry assert, and the conformance suite going green — was reasoned from the WPT expectations, not executed. Re-run the page and /conformance/ in Chrome 158 or Canary with the flags and record the readout.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Keyboard operation and focus-visible were verified via CDP, but chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable in this environment, so the full accessibility-tree inspection (names/roles/states as a screen reader sees them) was not performed per project rule 7b.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive demo control panel layout without horizontal overflow on narrow mobile viewport
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use flex-wrap and auto-fit minmax grids so control panels reflow instead of overflowing.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatch row uses flex-wrap; the native/custom comparison uses grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 17rem), 1fr)); range/progress get max-inline-size: 100%.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible color swatch picker buttons with aria-pressed and visible focus
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native buttons with explicit pressed state, ≥44px touch targets, visible focus indicators, and one polite live region per page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Swatches are native <button>s with aria-pressed and min-height 44px; selection shows a 3px outline; the single #readout is role=status aria-live=polite.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP keyboard walk: BUTTON rebeccapurple :: focus-visible=true, Enter activated and updated the readout.

guidanceConsulted.query: mobile-safe sizing for demo stages without viewport-unit traps
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Avoid 100vh traps and fixed widths; size with intrinsic/percentage units.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: No viewport units used; stages size intrinsically and panes use minmax(min(100%, …)).

summary: Canonical accent-mirror demo verified on Chromium 141 headless via CDP: honest three-tier probe correctly reports the unparsed tier, native controls visibly follow the picked accent while the chip stays in its labelled fallback, console clean, both viewport classes screenshot-verified. Chrome 158 follows-tier behaviour is pinned by the probe and conformance suite but needs a real 158 run.
